property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls every visible string (header buttons, field labels, modals, toasts).

property.name: separatorLabel
property.label: Separator label (override)
property.description: Leave empty to use the language default ('OR' / 'OU').

property.name: productImageFieldApiName
property.label: Product image field API name
property.description: Field on Product2 holding an image URL. Schema-safe: skipped if absent.

property.name: productImageFallbackUrl
property.label: Product image fallback URL
property.description: Used when the product field is empty or absent.
